features.rationale: Solid tie rod with two integral end collars and two reduced-diameter necks; preserve the printed axial dimension chain.
features.justification: Both necks share the diameter and typical width shown in the matching end details. Main body and collars retain the nominal reference stock diameter. Right collar width follows D002-D003-D004, not an assumed equal collar width.

features.rationale: Cut the centered longitudinal external keyway on the +X side, with its floor located from the opposite outside tangent.
features.justification: The end view locates the floor at D008-D001/2 and centers the width about the horizontal diameter. Longitudinal keyway lines show a full-length cut through the body and end collars, naturally interrupted by the smaller necks. Extend the cutting tool past both end faces and beyond the outside radius to avoid coincident boundaries.

features.rationale: What exact neck-root radius is required? The drawing specifies only a maximum.
Does C/R require a chamfer or a radius at the two outside end edges? Resolve the treatment before execution.

notes: Title block identifies TIE ROD, tool SB11780, model 120ME; material note reads MAT'L ~ 1018.
Contrary to extraction warnings, the full sheet explicitly specifies dimensions in inches, third-angle projection, and general tolerances: 2-place ±.02, 3-place ±.010, angular ±1°.
D001 is reference stock diameter; use its nominal value for the solid without replacing the controlling keyway floor dimension D008.
The nominal right collar width is D002-D003-D004 = .875; the central body length is D003-2*D005. Do not impose exact axial mirror symmetry.

D011-D013 are geometric tolerances rather than solid geometry: left inner collar shoulder is datum B; right shoulder has perpendicularity to A and parallelism to B. Confirm the precise datum A attachment for inspection.
MACHINE CENTERS PERMITTED authorizes optional manufacturing centers but does not require dimensioned holes; none are modeled.

CFS and the associated surface marking are retained as manufacturing annotations, not additional geometry. Unresolved edge treatments must not be applied using their provisional operation or maximum size.
